scripts.build: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/opencode && cp packages/opencode/src/*.py packages/opencode/dist/
scripts.pack:candidate: npm run build && mkdir -p dist && npm pack --workspaces --pack-destination dist && npm install --prefix dist --offline --no-audit --no-save --ignore-scripts ./dist/goatmr-core-$npm_package_version.tgz ./dist/goatmr-opencode-$npm_package_version.tgz
